thread:
rachel_ng: AuroraPayments POC kickoff. Goal: drop-in compat with vendor-old/v1/respond, minimal client changes. Key asks: prompt parity, predictable billing during migration, security checklist. 10-day POC.

Tom_ali: Do we have sample payloads? chat vs single-prompt will change shim. Also what p95 latency target?

rachel_ng: They shared ~600 examples (mostly chat arrays). Target p95=300ms but flexible to 600ms during heavy loads. Samples on drive.

priya_sharma: POC plan: 1) tiny compat shim translating vendor envelope -> redwood-chat API; 2) eval harness (500 samples) with deterministic settings temp=0; 3) normalizer to strip vendor debug fields and canonicalize dates/currency; 4) token delta + cost comparison report.

Dave_ops: Security asks: EU data residency, BYOK via Azure KV, 12mo audit log retention, signed DPA. Need allowlist IPs for staging.

infra-bot: staging env "aurora-poc-eu" created in eu-west-1. Firewall rules pending.

Tom_ali: Pricing: customer prefers flat per-call for 30 days. I'll prepare a flat-rate proposal and a tokenized projection for long-term. Need three representative token counts.

priya_sharma: I'll run A/B and produce semantic similarity + top-5 failure cases. Normalizer usually fixes formatting diffs.

rachel_ng: Can we smoke on Thu 08:00 CET? customer prefers morning.

Dave_ops: Thu morning works. I'll finalize allowlist and syslog export.

rachel_ng: Great. Action items: Tom=quote, Priya=eval harness, Dave=infra allowlist. I'll send calendar invite. Marking thread active.
